oneLine: Selzer Polymers Limited files DRHP with NSE Emerge for an IPO, offering future liquidity to promoters.

sources.title: Diversified Polymer Products Manufacturer Selzer Polymers Limited Files DRHP with NSE Emerge

synopsis: Selzer Polymers Limited, a Kerala-based polymer processing company manufacturing water tanks, industrial packaging, and solar floating systems, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the NSE Emerge platform for an initial public offering. The IPO consists entirely of a fresh issue of up to 34,00,000 equity shares with a face value of ₹10 each, with no offer for sale component. The company intends to use the net proceeds for capital expenditure to set up a new manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu, pre-payment or repayment of certain outstanding borrowings, funding working capital requirements, and general corporate purposes. GYR Capital Advisors Private Limited is the Book Running Lead Manager to the issue, while Bigshare Services Private Limited acts as the registrar. The company is led by Promoter and Managing Director Tony Pellissery Lonappan.
